title: Step 1a - Mastering Simple Linear Regression: Key Concepts and Implementation

cues.en: -: Hello my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，大家好。

cues.en: Congratulations again, for completing part one, data pre-processing.
cues.zh: 再次恭喜完成第一部分資料前處理。

cues.en: You are now ready to build machine learning models, and the first models that we're gonna build together are regression models.
cues.zh: 現在已準備好建立機器學習模型，第一批要一起建立的，是迴歸模型。

cues.en: So, welcome to part two, on regression.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到第二部分：迴歸。

cues.en: This is the branch of machine learning that aims to predict some continuous real numbers, like for example, a salary, or a temperature,
cues.zh: 這個機器學習分支的目的，是預測連續實數，例如薪資、溫度，

cues.en: or any kind of continuous numerical value.
cues.zh: 或其他任何連續數值。

cues.en: And together we will build the best models to make these predictions.
cues.zh: 我們會一起建立適合這些預測的模型。

cues.en: And so now, first of all, let's make sure we are all on the same page.
cues.zh: 首先，確保大家都在同一個起點。

cues.en: This is the whole machine learning, A to Z, folder containing all the codes in Python and R, and the datasets.
cues.zh: 這是完整的 Machine Learning A-Z 資料夾，包含全部 Python、R 程式與資料集。

cues.en: I gave you the link of this folder right before this tutorial, you know, in the article to make sure to connect to this folder.
cues.zh: 這堂課前面的文章已提供連結，請確認能開啟這個資料夾。

cues.en: And also, make sure to download the whole folder in order to get the datasets, because we will have indeed, to import them whenever we build a machine learning model.
cues.zh: 也請下載完整資料夾，取得資料集，因為每次建立模型都必須匯入資料。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And so now, since we're all on the same page, let's start our new journey within regression.
cues.zh: 既然準備好了，就展開迴歸的新旅程。

cues.en: Part two, regression, there we go.
cues.zh: 進入 Part 2 Regression。

cues.en: There are several sections inside each section corresponding to a different regression model.
cues.zh: 裡面有好幾個章節，每一章對應不同的迴歸模型。

cues.en: We're gonna start with simple linear regression, which is the simplest machine model you could ever build.
cues.zh: 先從簡單線性迴歸開始，這是最簡單的機器學習模型。

cues.en: And so, it's good that we start with this, because indeed, with this one, we will only have one independent variable, you know, one feature, and of course, one continuous real value to predict.
cues.zh: 用它當起點很適合，因為只有一個自變數，也就是一個特徵，以及一個要預測的連續實數。

cues.en: Then we will move on to multiple linear regression, which is based on the same equation than simple linear regression.
cues.zh: 接著是多元線性迴歸，和簡單線性迴歸使用相同基礎的方程式。

cues.en: Only this time we will have several features, instead of one.
cues.zh: 只是這次有多個特徵，而不是一個。

cues.en: Then we will move on to polynomial regression, which will allow us to tackle some non-linear datasets, you know, datasets with non-linear correlations,
cues.zh: 再來是多項式迴歸，可以處理非線性資料，也就是特徵與目標之間具有非線性關係的資料集。

cues.en: as opposed to the two previous models, simple linear regression and multiple linear regression, which can provide some amazing and accurate predictions for linear datasets, you know,
cues.zh: 相較之下，前面簡單與多元線性迴歸，適合對線性資料，

cues.en: datasets with linear correlations.
cues.zh: 也就是有線性關係的資料集，做出很好的預測。

cues.en: Then, after polynomial regression, we will move on to support vector regression, which is another kind of non-linear model, that can make some accurate predictions
cues.zh: 多項式迴歸之後，介紹支持向量迴歸，這是另一種非線性模型，能對

cues.en: for non-linear datasets with non-linear correlations.
cues.zh: 具有非線性關係的資料做出準確預測。

cues.en: And then finally, we will move on to decision tree regression and random forest regression, which can provide an alternative to predict an outcome for non-linear datasets.
cues.zh: 最後介紹決策樹迴歸與隨機森林迴歸，提供預測非線性資料結果的其他選擇。

cues.en: So, you'll have many options, you know, after this part two, you will have basically, a toolkit of several regression models.
cues.zh: 完成第二部分後，你會有很多選項，等於一個包含多種迴歸模型的工具箱。

cues.en: And so, whenever you end up with a new dataset where you have to predict a real continuous outcome, well, you can just try all of them, and select, in the end, the one that has the best accuracy.
cues.zh: 未來遇到要預測連續實數的新資料集，可以試試這些模型，再選表現最好的。

cues.en: And thanks to the code templates that will result from each of these sections, you know, you will get very clear code templates that you can adapt to your own datasets,
cues.zh: 每個章節都會產生清楚的程式模板，可以改用在自己的資料集，

cues.en: so that you can try these models on your own datasets in a flashlight, quickly and efficiently, so that you can select the best one, giving you the best accuracy.
cues.zh: 讓你快速、有效率地測試各模型，找出準確度最好的方案。

cues.en: And so now, in this first section in regression, we're gonna start with simple linear regression, of course.
cues.zh: 現在，迴歸的第一章，當然從簡單線性迴歸開始。

cues.en: So, there we go.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Make sure to go inside this folder.
cues.zh: 請進入這個資料夾。

cues.en: We're gonna start with Python.
cues.zh: 先用 Python。

cues.en: So, let's go inside this Python folder, and you will find inside two files.
cues.zh: 打開 Python 資料夾，裡面有兩個檔案。

cues.en: First, the dataset, salary data dot cv, and of course, our Python implementation which has the IPython notebook format, which I remind, you can run
cues.zh: 第一個是 Salary_Data.csv 資料集，第二個是 IPython Notebook 格式的 Python 實作，可以在

cues.en: on either Google Colab or Jupyter Notebook.
cues.zh: Google Colab 或 Jupyter Notebook 執行。

cues.en: And of course, we're gonna implement this model together on Google Colab.
cues.zh: 我們當然會在 Google Colab 一起實作。

cues.en: But first, let me explain the dataset, and the problem that we're gonna solve with simple linear regression.
cues.zh: 但先說明資料集，以及要用簡單線性迴歸解決的問題。

cues.en: And to do this, I'm going to open our dataset here, and explain what this is about.
cues.zh: 我先開啟資料，介紹內容。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So first, I wanna reassure you that indeed, this is a very simple dataset, you know, with only 30 observations, and of course, in real life, the datasets are more complex,
cues.zh: 先讓你放心，這是非常簡單、只有 30 筆觀測值的資料。真實資料當然更複雜，

cues.en: but I want to start working on a simple dataset, so that we can really focus on how to build the model itself.
cues.zh: 但先用簡單資料，才能專注學習如何建立模型本身。

cues.en: You know, because if we had a complex dataset we would lose a bit, our focus on the model.
cues.zh: 如果資料太複雜，會分散對模型的注意力。

cues.en: And I really want us to focus on the model.
cues.zh: 我希望大家專注在模型上。

cues.en: So, let me describe the dataset.
cues.zh: 來介紹資料集。

cues.en: It is a dataset containing, as you can see 30 observations, and two columns with of course, one feature.
cues.zh: 可以看到，共 30 筆觀測值、兩個欄位，而且只有一個特徵。

cues.en: This is the feature, years of experience, and the dependent variable, which we want to predict, which is the salary.
cues.zh: 特徵是工作年資，依變數，也就是要預測的是薪資。

cues.en: So, let's say that this dataset belongs to a company, that gathered data of some of their employees, collecting for each of them, their years of experience and their salary.
cues.zh: 假設某家公司蒐集部分員工的資料，記錄每個人的工作年資與薪資。

cues.en: So you see, each row of the dataset here, corresponds to different employees.
cues.zh: 所以每一列都對應不同員工。

cues.en: Corresponds to one employee of the company, and for each employee of this company, we have indeed, the number of years of experience in the company, and their salary, okay?
cues.zh: 一列代表公司的一位員工，包含年資與薪資。

cues.en: And so, the goal, very simply, is to build a simple linear regression model, that will be trained to understand the correlations between
cues.zh: 目標很簡單，建立簡單線性迴歸模型，訓練它了解

cues.en: the number of years of experience and the salary, so that it can predict for a new employee, you know, having a new number of years of experience,
cues.zh: 年資與薪資的關係，才能對有不同年資的新員工，

cues.en: well, the corresponding salary, or the salary that this person should get.
cues.zh: 預測相應薪資，或他應該領多少薪水。

cues.en: So you see, that's a very easy problem, but at least you'll know how to build a simple linear regression model, and perfectly master it in all the detail.
cues.zh: 這是很簡單的問題，但至少能讓你學會建立簡單線性迴歸，掌握各種細節。

cues.en: And then I wanna say something very important.
cues.zh: 還有一件非常重要的事。

cues.en: Remember that, we're gonna build, each time, some code templates, which you can adapt to your own datasets, so that when you want to use the code template on your own dataset,
cues.zh: 每次都會建立能改用到其他資料集的程式模板，這樣之後換成自己的資料時，

cues.en: you will only have one thing to change, which will be the name of your data.
cues.zh: 只需要改一件事，就是資料集名稱。

cues.en: I will always make sure to make the code templates as much generic as we can, so that you only have one or two things to change when you want to deploy them on your datasets.
cues.zh: 我會盡量讓模板通用，讓你只改一兩個地方，就能套用到自己的資料。
